facts.text: Final report dated July 31, 2026, prepared by Stantec Consulting Ltd. for Canada Lands Company Limited. Project/file 1609410368.
The subject property is a designated heritage property under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (Campanile Campus, also known as the Federal Study Centre).

Adaptive-reuse considerations: the buildings 'require extensive upgrades to meet contemporary standards including building code deficiencies, barrier-free accessibility, mechanical and electrical upgrades, seismic upgrades, and remediation of hazardous and designated substances'.
Accessibility: alterations needed to make the heritage buildings fully accessible 'may include the installation of elevators, ramps, modifications to doors'.
The proposed design 'considers barrier-free access throughout the site'.
Section 7, 'Alternatives and Mitigation Strategies', covers heritage options (for example 'Retention In Situ'), not Building Code alternative solutions.

limitations: Comparative only: Ontario, non-Alberta. A heritage planning report, not a Building Code analysis.
